description: This source file contains code-behind logic for the TheorySet web page in an online examination system. It handles UI events such as page load, button clicks, dropdown selections, and database interactions for managing theory questions and courses.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheorySet ASP.NET WebForms page, managing UI events and database operations related to course and question management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, currently with commented out code initializing session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin queue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester, with options for different years and semesters.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database, updates question number, and shows confirmation alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Sets up a new course exam in the database and navigates to the admin panel.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for question text and marks.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the login page, logging out.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on selected course.
